name: Zeiskam (Germany)
description: Quartered yellow and green, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Zeiskam (a letter Z with ears of wheat above a ringed cross on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Zeiskam; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Zeiskam arms — letter Z, ears and ringed cross on yellow
